newsitem.title: JAPAN: G7 meeting sent good signal to markets -- Japan PM.
newsitem.headline: G7 meeting sent good signal to markets -- Japan PM.

text.p: The Group of Seven (G7) meeting in Berlin at the weekend sent an "extremely good signal" to financial markets, Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto told a parliamentary committee on Monday.

Hashimoto said Japan had been able to secure the statements it wanted from the other G7 countries and added that cooperative ties remained steadfast with each country vowing to do its best to improve their economies.
"In this sense, I think, under the present conditions, it sent an extremely good signal to the market," he said.
